name: Read Later
description: Lists the contents of the "Read Later" clip filled by the "Read Later" plugin (reading-list) as an unread list. Click an item to open the note detail window, or press "✓ 読んだ" (Read) to remove it from the clip. The clip is looked up by name (default 「後で読む」, changeable in settings), so no clip ID setup is needed; if it does not exist the widget only shows a hint and leaves creation to the plugin. Refreshes every 5 minutes. No token setup required.
